source_scope: §4.1.1 Eq. (14)–(15): one fixed level and deterministic unit directions, under the unconditioned joint coefficient law. This isolates an unnamed scalar Gaussian consequence; it is not Lemma 4.4 or Eq. (51).
signature:
theorem angularDegreeSum_hasLaw (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (hu : ∀ j, ‖u j‖ = 1) :
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := Fin (h + 1) × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun p : P ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
    let F := fun (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)) ↦ ∑ p : P,
      angularDegreeComponent n h i (degree p) u
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun c : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), c⟩))
    HasLaw F (gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * ∑ p : P, (a p) ^ 2).toNNReal))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)))

TYPING: n positive; h natural; i in 0..h; u contains exactly the trailing directions.
P indexes exactly the even p between 4 and 2^(64(h+1)); B and C preserve the actual ordered tensor carrier.
STANDING: The source relates depth to sufficiently large dimension. The isolated scalar identity needs no such relation and does not generalize admissibility.
SOURCE: Each deterministic trailing vector lies on the unit sphere, represented by hu.
derived_not_assumed: Block independence and marginals, measurability of the scalar sum, square integrability and exact Gaussian law.
